description: Land Title Settlement Department - Makuddala, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610016 (22/14/23/0028
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details) in various villages, with detailed schedules showing land ownership information. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined for Type 4 classification.
